message: `BUNDLE_COOLDOWN: "14" # two weeks` in .bundle/config sets BUNDLE_COOLDOWN to the text "\"14\"" (Bundler reads the file line by line, not as YAML), which to_i reads as 0, so it turns off the cooldown of Bundler for every source, in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile; Bundler reads .bundle/config before the environment
fix: Remove BUNDLE_COOLDOWN from .bundle/config (bundle config unset --local cooldown), so that the cooldown: of the Gemfile applies, or set it to at least 3 (bundle config set --local cooldown 3)
